name: Complete Blood Count (CBC)
shortDescription: Complete blood count including blood cell measurements

name: HbA1c (Glycated Hemoglobin)
shortDescription: Estimates average blood glucose over the previous 2–3 months

name: Liver Function Test (LFT)
shortDescription: Assesses markers associated with liver function

name: Urine Complete Examination
shortDescription: Routine physical, chemical and microscopic urine examination

name: Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR)
shortDescription: Measures the rate at which red blood cells settle

name: Blood Culture
shortDescription: Culture test to detect organisms in blood
